en.gameDesc: Use the pumping lemma to prove languages are not context-free. Decompose words into uvxyz and show that pumping leads to a contradiction.

af.gameDesc: Gebruik die pomplemma om te bewys dat tale nie konteksvry is nie. Ontbind woorde in uvxyz en wys dat pomping tot 'n teenstrydigheid lei.

zu.gameDesc: Sebenzisa umthetho wokupompa ukufakazela ukuthi izilimi aziyona ikonteksi-fri. Hlukanisa amagama abe yi-uvxyz ukhombise ukuthi ukupompa kuholela ekuphikisaneni.
